name: Auto Click Mod
description: Auto Macro Bot: auto-plays a path through your level, records it, and lets you replay it with one button.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Runs that use the bot (Auto Path or Replay) never save progress or completions. Leave this on if you care about legit stats and leaderboards.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: While the bot is active, draws the real hitboxes the game collides with: red = hazards, blue = solid blocks, yellow = your hitbox, cyan = the small inner hitbox.

hitbox-trail.name: Hitbox Trail
hitbox-trail.description: While the bot is active, draws a fading trail of where your hitbox has been, plus the path the bot plans to jump along (green = safe jump found, orange = best guess).

show-hud.name: Show HUD
show-hud.description: Shows a small "Auto Macro Bot" status label in the top-left corner while the bot is active.
